verses.text: Mamin Jehová, swal in b'a t'ayach, kotanh t'a elanhchamel. Ab' in jaj ayik swalan in b'a t'a ichanh.
Mamin, wach'okab' sk'ek'och in lesal icha wal sk'e stab'il incienso t'a ichanh. Haxo in k'ab' mojank'e t'ayach, lajanokab' wal icha ofrenda t'a yemk'uhalil t'a yol a sat.
Mamin Jehová, tanhwej in ti', yik wach' manh ol wal chukal lolonel.
Najat tzik'kanel chukal t'a in pensar. Manh in a cha b'eyek' t'a chukal b'eyb'al. Manh in a chab'at wa'el b'aj ay sniwak wa'el heb' sk'ulan chukal.

Tato a junok anima wach' tzin mak'ani, wach'ton tzin yutej. Tato tzin stumej, icha wal to syak'och perfume t'ayin, yuj chi' scha in k'o'ol. Palta tzin lesalwinhej yik wach' syamchajoch wa'an tas sk'ulej heb' chuk.
Ha heb' yajalil heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol ekchajb'at heb' t'a sattak tenam, icha chi' ol aj yilan heb' anima to yel ix wala'.
Ha sb'akil heb', sakleminak ol ajkanb'at b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, icha tz'ajkanb'at lum lum ayik sb'oji junok olan.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal ach, ay wal och in pensar t'ayach. Ha t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il, manh in aktejkani.
Kolinel t'a sya'al heb' tz'ak'an chukal t'ayin.
Kanokab' heb' chuk chi' t'a sya'al chi', a inxo jun, ol in ek'nhej.
